bounded_host_request.command:
cd /home/admin1/server-core || exit 12
printf 'IDENTITY=%s\n' "$(id -un)"
if getent passwd admin2 >/dev/null; then
  echo 'ADMIN2_EXISTS=YES'
  printf 'ADMIN2_GROUPS='; id -nG admin2
  getent passwd admin2 | awk -F: '{printf "ADMIN2_SHELL=%s ADMIN2_HOME=%s\n",$7,$6}'
  if test -d /home/admin2/.ssh; then echo 'ADMIN2_SSH_DIR=EXISTS'; else echo 'ADMIN2_SSH_DIR=MISSING'; fi
  if test -f /home/admin2/.ssh/authorized_keys; then echo 'ADMIN2_AUTHORIZED_KEYS=EXISTS'; else echo 'ADMIN2_AUTHORIZED_KEYS=MISSING'; fi
else echo 'ADMIN2_EXISTS=NO'; fi
printf 'ADMIN1_GROUPS='; id -nG admin1
if sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then echo 'NONINTERACTIVE_SUDO=YES'; else echo 'NONINTERACTIVE_SUDO=NO'; fi
